name: Boot Camp
lede: Four missions, about ten minutes each. You try something first, then find out why it worked. Jump to any mission in any order.
description: Level 1 of an interactive AI course for marketers: four short missions with games, quizzes, XP, and a real prompt to run.

missions.name: Guess the Next Word
missions.hook: Every AI writing tool is, at heart, a very good guesser. You are about to guess alongside it.
missions.objective: See how an AI picks its next word, and how your context changes the odds.

missions.name: Brief the Machine
missions.hook: Same AI, same task, five different answers. The only thing that changes is what you tell it. Add one ingredient at a time and watch.
missions.objective: Add four prompt ingredients one at a time and see how each one improves the result.

missions.name: Spot the Fake
missions.hook: AI writes confident sentences whether or not they are true. Your job is catching the bad one before it ships. Three rounds, one problem sentence in each.
missions.objective: Catch the invented number, quote, or rule in an AI draft before it ships.

missions.name: Your First Win
missions.hook: Time for the real thing. Fill in a few boxes, copy the prompt, paste it into any AI tool you already use, then grade what comes back.
missions.objective: Write a complete prompt for your own offer, run it, and grade what comes back.

recap: AI ranks likely next words. Context moves the odds.
Audience, goal, rules, and voice turn a generic answer into yours.
Check numbers, quotes, dates, and “always.” The AI cannot vouch for itself.
You ran a real prompt and graded the result.
next: Next up: Level 2, Prompt Craft. Build a reusable prompt kit for ads, emails, and landing pages.
